newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hansom soars over 31 pct in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Hansom soars over 31 pct in morning trade.

text.p: Shares of construction firm Hansom Holdings Ltd continued to rise sharply on Wednesday morning after the company said it was not aware of any reason behind the recent price rise on its shares.
The shares rose HK$0.37, or 31.36 percent, to HK$1.55 in late morning. They have risen more than 100 percent from their Friday close of HK$0.71.
Hansom said on Wednesday that there were no talks or agreements relating to intended acquisitions or realisations which were discloseable.
Neither was the company aware of any matter discloseable which was or might be of a price-senstitive nature, it said in a statement issued through the stock exchange.
Brokers said the recent rally was due to speculation that a Chinese firm was mulling buying into the company.
Officials at Hansom were not immediate available for comment.
